changelog: Admin Bookings are now grouped by date instead of showing every upcoming booking as a separate top-level card.
Tap a date such as September 3 to expand or collapse all bookings scheduled on that date.
Each booking inside an expanded date remains tappable and opens Booking Details.
Cancel Booking remains available only inside an upcoming booking's details, and Delete Booking remains available only inside a cancelled booking's details.
Calendar day popup, public date-first Bookings and the latest 0-0-2 gameplay are preserved.
